_readme: Sprite manifest: maps logical ids to texture files under Content/Assets.
Entries without a 'texture' field (or whose file is missing) fall back to
generated placeholder shapes, so the game always runs. To re-skin the game,
drop PNGs here and add texture/x/y/w/h/originX/originY to the entries below —
no code changes or content rebuild needed.
Tiles pivot at the diamond center by default; units pivot at bottom-center (feet).
